title: Write the threat map
goal: The risks of openbando are listed with their evidence
acceptance: `docs/security/threats.md` has one row per applicable LLM top 10 risk: what reaches the model, a tool or a key, the control, the test that proves it or the gap record (a real record id) that owns the fix
Every gap opens or cites a record with an owner; the checker passes in CI
No secret values or personal data in the page
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Reading the repository once for external input, tools and keys, then 8 to 12 rows. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
